Respond  Through:
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 22.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7539/2023-EX.
Allowed subject to all just exceptions.

This is a petition seeking setting of the impugned order dated 24.11.2022 passed by CBI, Court No.
16, Rouse Avenue District Courts, New Delhi in CBI Case No. 115/2019 (CNR No.
DLCT110005142019) titled as CBI vs. Vinod Gupta  ETC. (SLEUTH CGHS) arising out of RC No.
SIJ2006E0006/EO-II/CBI under Section 120B IPC read with Section 420/468/471 IPC and Section 13(2) read with 13(1)(d) of the PC Act, 1988, wherein the accused persons i.e. the respondents have been discharged.

entities.text:
CBI, Court No.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: CBI vs. Vinod Gupta  ETC. (SLEUTH CGHS)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated by Mr. Jain, learned special counsel for CBI that once there is prima facie finding by the learned Sessions Court that the documents have been forged and the only people who could have forged the documents were the respondents, charges should have been framed regardless of the non- filing of the some relevant documents.
For the said reasons, issue notice to the respondents through all modes including electronic on the petitioner taking steps within 1 week from today.
